Apple has reduced the retail price of its iPhone 17 Pro Max to Rs 74,990 at Croma stores across India, marking a notable adjustment after earlier price hikes.

The Croma promotion bundles an exchange‑bonus scheme, a free protective case and an additional 10% discount on the listed price, aiming to enhance the offer’s value proposition for buyers.
